thread:
Elena P: Thanks for the great turnout in today's AH. Capturing a short, action-focused rollup from the live Q&A so owners can pick items. No long prose.

Ava M: Quick question we got live: can customers pin a model revision for Dedicated and still get automatic security/patch updates?

Diego P: Short answer: yes for security patches only. Pinning locks the model artifact/version; infra will still apply non-model VM/agent security patches. We need a docs blurb to explain the tradeoffs. @Ava M any concerns for product copy?

Ava M: That works. I'll draft the copy clarifying patch scope and opt-in for automatic minor updates.

Harper S: Ops Q from chat: retention for request traces in the Console — is 30 days default or 90? Also any paid add-on?

Noah L: Default is 30 days. We will offer 90/180 as paid tiers. Need pricing + telemetry limits for the billing page. @Maya L FYI (cc: not in thread).

Sam J: Private deployment timeline ask: customers asked when Private (VPC-managed control plane) will support HSM/KMS integration. What's realistic?

Elena P: Target for HSM-enabled Private is end of Q3. We will ship a beta for select customers in mid-Q3. Need an internal beta sign-up doc.

Diego P: For model routing question: during region outages do we prefer model-variant substitution or cross-region failover? Live answer was variant substitution first to avoid cross-region data movement. Will write the failure matrix doc.

Ava M: Also asked about roadmap visibility: can we expose a short public timeline for major infra features (Dedicated GA, Private HSM, Longer trace retention)? Product comfortable with a high-level schedule. I can prepare a public-friendly one-pager.

deploy-bot: release pipeline: canary for dedicated-ga branch scheduled 2024-05-06T18:00Z (ticket: #4921).

Elena P: Owners I captured (please reply with "taking" to claim):
- Ava M: public one-pager + pinning doc blurb
- Diego P: failure matrix doc + routing priority table
- Noah L: trace-retention tiers + pricing blurb
- Sam J: private beta sign-up doc for HSM/KMS

Action checklist (short):
- [ ] pinning & patch policy blurb (Ava)
- [ ] failure matrix + example config (Diego)
- [ ] retention tiers & pricing lines (Noah)
- [ ] private HSM beta sign-up doc (Sam)
- [ ] announcement copy for Dedicated GA (Elena)

Ava M: taking (will post draft by tomorrow noon).

Diego P: taking 1 will attach a small example table + YAML for routing fallback.

Noah L: taking 1 will propose 90/180 pricing and telemetry caps by end of week.

Sam J: taking 1 will create the beta signup doc and a short applicant checklist.

Elena P: Thanks all 44d. I'll slot announcement copy once we have the PRs/docs. If anyone wants help with wording ping me or drop a short comment.
